capabilities: Sync notes and attachments through a self-hosted server
Encrypt file contents and paths with AES-256-GCM
Share themes, CSS snippets, hotkeys and selected plugin settings
Compare installed community plugin lists across devices
Keep conflict copies of competing changes
extras: Experimental; requires a self-hosted server and shared Vault ID/encryption key; the server cannot recover a lost key; keep independent backups.
problem: Users who want to sync a vault through their own server need a client that encrypts file contents and paths before sending them.

relations.evidence: Your own Ajimo Sync Server, reachable over HTTPS.

summary: End-to-end encrypted sync plugin that moves notes, attachments, themes, snippets, hotkeys and selected plugin settings through a self-hosted server.
